programs.title: X: The Generation That Changed the World
programs.desc:
Often called outsiders, searching for the meaning of their own existence, working from dawn to dusk, although rejecting the rat race and excessive consumerism - generationThe filmmakers will trace all the most important events that influenced the formation of representatives of this generation.Viewers will learn how the development of technology - from the pocket calculator to the birth of Google - social and political upheavals and the emergence of mass culture have changed their everyday lives.
In the episode we will see how groundbreaking events during the youth of Generation X led to changes in social and economic life, and even in the way societies think.We will also learn how hip-hop culture has become an integral part of the lives of representatives of this generation.And finally, how did the oil crisis affect the way they lived and functioned.The program includes interviews with, among others:with hip-hop pioneers, journalists and representatives of the MTV music station.

programs.title: Lost Treasures of The Maya
programs.desc: Albert Lin spent many months in the Guatemalan jungle in the company of an international team of scientists.He recorded material at twelve major archaeological sites.The researchers had at their disposal a LiDAR device that works similarly to an X-ray.It allowed the terrain to be scanned from the air.Thanks to this, a digital map was developed.A special application was also created showing the local landscape without forests.Therefore, there was no need to cut down the trees.Objects that were part of previously unknown cities were found, including pyramids and a fortified citadel.They also found the skeleton of the queen, the ruler's burial chamber with richly decorated ritual vessels, fragments of the skull of a sacrificed child, bas-reliefs, a stone altar, a painted vase, as well as dozens of statuettes and ceramic objects.The discoveries made allowed us to re-evaluate the current knowledge about the Mayan civilization.
